title: C5/C7 build-side: emit L1 runtime-exec twins of contract spec fns (count_sep/sep_free/occurs_at/contains_sub/all_digits/is_digit/parse_u64) + Vec<String> exec len, so forge build of contract-using programs runs

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Emitted the C5/C7 L1 runtime-exec twins in thermite-lower::l1::emit_string_runtime_l1: C5 family occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free (gated on program_uses_string_search) + C7 family is_digit/all_digits/free parse_u64/parse_be (gated on program_uses_parse, parse_be deduped vs the C4 numfmt round-trip). lower_expr_exec's Call arm .clone()s the leading string args (string_arg_count_l1) to handle the by-value/&-snapshot ambiguity uniformly. TVecTString exec len() -> u64 already emitted by emit_vec_runtime_l1 (every TVec wrapper). forge build of the full calc.th now compiles+runs (add_2_3 -> Some(5), add_100_200 -> Some(300)); full parse_lines.th compiles+runs (split_abc -> 3 pieces [97],[98],[99]); formatter unaffected; forge check unchanged (L3). The 2 pinned tests flipped to assert build success. Gauntlet: cargo build workspace OK; cargo test --workspace 192 passed/0 failed; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Mirror the C4 precedent: in thermite-lower::l1::emit_string_runtime_l1 emit EXEC twins of the C5 contract spec fns (occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free) under program_uses_string_search and the C7 spec fns (is_digit/all_digits/free parse_u64/parse_be) under program_uses_parse, each computing the same value as its spec body over the runtime Vec<u8>. Handle the by-value/&-snapshot call-site ambiguity by .clone()-ing leading string args (string_arg_count_l1) in lower_expr_exec's Call arm. parse_be deduped against the numfmt round-trip. TVecTString exec len already exists. Flip the 2 pinned acceptance tests to assert build success + correct run. Mirror the L1-exec-twin note to 07-strings.md / 09-option-result.md REQ status. Gauntlet: build/test workspace, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check.
